payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative 1D DP: dp[i] = length of longest non-decreasing subarray ending at i; dp[i] = dp[i-1]+1 if A[i]>=A[i-1] else 1; answer = sum(dp).
payload.rationale: Solution computes per-index lengths using a simple recurrence that only depends on previous value, fitting 1D state DP. Not 2D, tree, interval, or combinatorics.
